newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks fall on position squaring.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks fall on position squaring.

text.p: Pakistani stocks fell in early trading on Friday amid selling pressue due to position-squaring by jobbers before the Saturday-Sunday weekend, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange said.

The Karachi 100-share index fell 3.24 points, or 0.21 percent, to 1,549.56 in the first 90 minutes of trade. Losers led gainers 124 to 55. Jobbers usually book profit and square their holdings before the weekend, one dealer said.
ICI Pakistan fell 0.20 to 24.15 rupees, PTCL 0.30 to 25.25 and Fauji Fertiliser 1.00 to 84 at 0600 GMT. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
